answer: Each identity earns standing by auditing 10 anonymized dossiers weekly, 2 secretly planted by the protocol; planted examples include a reused vine trellis photo, a ridge camera claimed twice, and a fake dune plot. Verifiers score reviews against the plant record; missing over 1 plant or falsely accusing an honest case revokes the slot. 1,000 Sybils need 10,000 careful reviews weekly, about 20 minutes each (3,333 hours), while automated rubber-stamping reliably hits a plant and fails. Trade-off: honest agents carry a weekly review burden and borderline cases need appeal.
